coordinator_corrections: New accepted events cannot include a pre-publication withdrawal/reinstatement chain.
Combined timeline checks every relevant claim/field/validity batch, preventing hidden support lapses or acceptance while withdrawn.
Every accepted factual-field review cites exact support accepted at its own time.
Every historical/current withdrawal has basis evidence accepted at its review time.
Correction review requires the original withdrawn and replacements accepted at that review time.
Reinstatement must explicitly retire conflicting current correction claims.
Retained records compare canonical serialization, distinguishing Boolean and numeric values.
Current and historical correction acceptance requires the exact self-cited source claim.
migration_design_difference: Rejected-root migration is permitted only against a supplied previously accepted legacy baseline. This avoids inventing a current validity acceptance for a known incorrect event. Production integration must pin and validate the actual predecessor profile, receipt, identities, evidence and chronology; the development function does not authenticate a supplied dictionary.
remaining_scope: New profile/plan, historical_fields, source-proof/promotion/offline-history integration, consumer/CSV/status exports, portable restore and substantive five-event migration review remain open. No P7 closure claimed.
